items.title: Bob Kinkel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 31, 2012
items.q: I actually took piano from him for one year.

ctx.x: Near Buffalo, where I grew up. And so I brought this piece in and he goes, “you know that’s a piano piece.” And I go, “it is?” You know, I had no clue. And he was really nice. He bought me the music so I started learning that, and then, you know I’d practice all the time and my chops were really getting strong on my own. And then when I got up here I thought I could take piano lessons, so Albert Bowen was one of the adjunct people. He lived down in Clinton, and he was a quasi-official person up here. And so I…
